project: Plague Island: 30 Days Trapped With Zero Signal

characters.name: The Survivor (unnamed narrator, addressed as 'you')
characters.approximate_age: Not established; draw as an adult around 35 (assumed)
characters.face_and_hairstyle: Lean, angular, gaunt face with high cheekbones, hollow tired eyes with dark under-eye shadows, short unkempt dark hair, no beard. Gender is never stated in the story, so the face is kept androgynous and often shadowed.
characters.clothing: Dark olive waxed rain jacket over charcoal wool sweater, dark work trousers, black rubber boots (assumed everyday island wear). Gear escalates: Day 11 soda-bottle charcoal mask and swimming goggles; Day 19-20 black contractor-bag suit sealed with silver duct tape at wrists, ankles and torso.
recognizable_features: Lean build and flat, cold stare
Gets visibly more exhausted and filthier with each Day
Silver duct tape and the soda-bottle charcoal mask are signature props
characters.personality: Cold, calculating and survival-first; deliberately unsentimental (ignores the dying butcher, stays silent for the doctor's wife) yet patient, resourceful and calm under extreme fear.
visual_consistency_rules: Same face, hair and olive jacket in every scene
Follow the gear states in order: base, then mask (Day 11), then suit (Day 19), then full (Day 20 to end)
No weapons: the story gives none
Face stays mostly shadowed, turned away or behind goggles until the reveal in S33
Walks, never runs, while in the plastic suit
characters.prompt_descriptor: the Survivor, a lean adult islander with short unkempt dark hair, gaunt angular face with hollow tired eyes and dark under-eye shadows, wearing a dark olive waxed rain jacket over a charcoal wool sweater, dark work trousers and black rubber boots

characters.name: The Butcher (the visual script calls him a fisherman)
characters.face_and_hairstyle: Broad weathered face, thick grey-streaked moustache, thinning short grey hair. Black veins spiderweb across his neck and blood coats his teeth.
characters.clothing: Blood-stained off-white butcher's apron over a thick wool fisherman's sweater, sleeves rolled, heavy rubber boots (merges the 'butcher' voiceover and 'fisherman' visual).
recognizable_features: Black veins on neck and jaw
characters.personality: Gruff, ordinary tradesman; a helpless collapsing victim.
visual_consistency_rules: Appears only in S03
Keep infection signs to neck and jaw so he reads as an early stage
Stocky silhouette must differ clearly from the survivor
characters.prompt_descriptor: the Butcher, a heavy-set man around 55 with a broad weathered face, thick grey-streaked moustache and thinning grey hair, blood-stained off-white butcher's apron over a thick wool fisherman's sweater, black veins spiderwebbing over his neck and blood on his teeth

characters.name: The Doctor's Wife
characters.face_and_hairstyle: Narrow tear-streaked face, red-rimmed eyes, grey-streaked dark hair in a loosening bun with strands stuck to wet cheeks; faint dark veins creeping up her throat, flecks of blood at her lips.
characters.clothing: Long dark wool coat thrown over a pale nightdress, muddy hem, bare chapped hands.
characters.personality: Kind, devoted, frightened and desperate; embodies 'the good people die first'.
visual_consistency_rules: Appears only at midnight on Day 1 (S08)
Show early infection, not zombie-like behaviour
Never shown entering the cabin
characters.prompt_descriptor: the Doctor's Wife, a woman around 45 with a narrow tear-streaked face, grey-streaked dark hair in a loosening bun, red-rimmed eyes, faint dark veins on her throat, wearing a long dark wool coat over a pale nightdress with a muddy hem

characters.name: The Ferry Captain
characters.face_and_hairstyle: Weathered ruddy square face with deep squint lines and short white stubble.
characters.clothing: Navy peacoat and peaked captain's cap, binoculars in hand.
characters.personality: Dutiful and grim; follows orders he clearly dislikes.
visual_consistency_rules: Seen only as a small figure in the wheelhouse window (S01)
No national insignia on cap or ship
characters.prompt_descriptor: the Ferry Captain, a weathered man around 60 with a ruddy square face and short white stubble, wearing a navy peacoat and a peaked cap, holding binoculars

characters.name: Healthy Villagers (group)
characters.face_and_hairstyle: Ordinary working-class islanders, mixed ages, worry-lined faces, practical haircuts.
characters.clothing: Oilskin coats, wool caps, knitted scarves, aprons, rubber boots.
characters.personality: Compassionate and terrified; rush to help, later gaunt and desperate.
visual_consistency_rules: Same coats throughout
Noticeably more gaunt and ill by Day 5 (S10)
Never touching the survivor
characters.prompt_descriptor: ordinary islanders of mixed ages in oilskin coats, wool caps, knitted scarves and rubber boots with worry-lined faces

characters.name: The Infected (horde)
characters.face_and_hairstyle: Pale grey skin, dark veins spidering across faces and necks, clouded vacant eyes (optional faint sickly yellow-green glint), wet matted hair, slack mouths.
characters.clothing: Soaked everyday clothes and sleepwear, torn from wandering in the rain, bare feet or muddy boots.
recognizable_features: Steam rising from fevered skin in cold air
characters.personality: Delirious and mindless after fever; seek warmth and any living person.
visual_consistency_rules: Slow shuffling, never sprinting
Group sizes: 4 in the yard (S16), 11 at the back door (S21), 20-25 at the pier (S25, S29)
Vacant stare, no snarling monster poses
Image 1 creature is a mood reference only; it is not a story character
characters.prompt_descriptor: infected villagers with pale grey skin, dark veins spidering across faces and necks, clouded vacant eyes, wet matted hair, soaked everyday clothes and sleepwear, gaunt shivering bodies, slack open mouths

characters.name: The Dead Coast Guard Officer
characters.face_and_hairstyle: Pale face with half-closed eyes, dark veins visible on her throat; hair tied back.
characters.clothing: Blue Coast Guard jacket, bandage around one arm.
recognizable_features: Satellite phone and open laminated folder in her lap
Boat keys on the desk beside her
characters.personality: Dutiful (she signalled and stayed); dead since the day before.
visual_consistency_rules: Seen only in the lantern room (S32, S36)
Never show visible gore beyond bandage and veins
No real-world national insignia
characters.prompt_descriptor: a dead Coast Guard officer, a woman around 35 in a blue Coast Guard jacket with a bandage around one arm, dark veins on her throat, pale skin, eyes half closed
